item.title: Improvement in condition of soldiers wounded in Lebanon
item.description:
Rambam Health Care Campus reported that the condition of the four reserve soldiers wounded in Lebanon yesterday has stabilized.
One of the soldiers has regained consciousness, while the other three remain sedated and on ventilators.

item.title: IDF responds to deadly ceasefire violations, strikes Hezbollah targets across southern Lebanon
item.description:
In response to the incident yesterday (Wednesday), during which Major (Res.) Harel Birenstock and Sergeant Major (Res.) Tamir Vaknin fell, and four IDF soldiers were severely injured in an explosion in the area of Majdal Zoun, the IDF struck over the past 24 hours Hezbollah terror infrastructure in several areas across southern Lebanon.
Among the targets struck were weapon storage facilities, a command center, and additional terror infrastructure.
